description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OnlineShop"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginRequest" name="Login credentials"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LoginResult" name="Login confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderSubmission" name="Order submission"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentReady" name="Payment preparation ready"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BankConfirmation" name="Bank payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShippingDetails" name="Shipping and billing address"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentStatus" name="Payment confirmation for order"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shop" name="E-Shop system" processRef="Process_Shop"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank" processRef="Process_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginRequest" name="Submit credentials" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCredentials" targetRef="Start_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_LoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LoginResult" name="Login confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginResult" targetRef="Task_WaitLoginResult" messageRef="Message_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderSubmission" name="Submit order" sourceRef="Task_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrder" messageRef="Message_OrderSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentReady" name="Payment preparation ready" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentReady" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentReady" messageRef="Message_PaymentReady"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentData" name="Payment data" sourceRef="Task_SubmitPaymentData" targetRef="Start_PaymentData" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BankConfirmation" name="Bank confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendBankConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBankConfirmation" messageRef="Message_BankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShippingDetails" name="Shipping and billing address" sourceRef="Task_SendAddress" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAddress" messageRef="Message_ShippingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentStatus" name="Payment confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentStatus" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentStatus" messageRef="Message_PaymentStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ordering" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerLogin" name="Log in to the E-Shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitCredentials" name="Submit credentials" messageRef="Message_LoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_WaitLoginResult" name="Wait for login confirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LoginSuccess" name="Login successful?" default="Flow_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LoginFailure" name="Shopping stops"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select a product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" name="Every product selected?" default="Flow_MoreProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitOrder" name="Submit order" messageRef="Message_OrderSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePaymentReady" name="Wait for payment preparation" messageRef="Message_PaymentReady"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterPaymentData" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitPaymentData" name="Submit payment data" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerParallelSplit" name="Wait for payment and enter address"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveBankConfirmation" name="Wait for bank confirmation" messageRef="Message_BankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentStatus" name="Send payment confirmation to E-Shop" messageRef="Message_PaymentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddressComparison" name="Shipping address equals billing address?" default="Flow_DifferentAddress"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAddress" name="Send address details to E-Shop" messageRef="Message_ShippingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CustomerParallelJoin" name="Payment and address steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerOrdering" name="Customer steps complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_CustomerLogin" targetRef="Task_SubmitCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_SubmitCredentials" targetRef="Task_WaitLoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_WaitLoginResult" targetRef="Gateway_LoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginSuccess" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginSuccess" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">loginSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LoginFailure" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginSuccess" targetRef="End_LoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllProductsYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SubmitOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allProductsSelected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoreProducts" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_8" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePaymentReady" targetRef="Task_EnterPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_9" sourceRef="Task_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="Task_SubmitPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Task_SubmitPaymentData" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_PayBranch" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveBankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_AddressBranch" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_11" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveBankConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_12" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentStatus" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_13" sourceRef="Task_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_AddressComparison"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddressSame" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AddressComparison" targetRef="Task_SendAddress">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">shippingAddressEqualsBillingAddress</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DifferentAddress" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AddressComparison" targetRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_14" sourceRef="Task_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Task_SendAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_15" sourceRef="Task_SendAddress" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_16" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerParallelJoin" targetRef="End_CustomerOrdering"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shop" name="E-Shop order processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_LoginRequest" name="Receive login request">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LoginRequest" messageRef="Message_LoginRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLoginResult" name="Send login confirmation" messageRef="Message_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShopLoginSuccess" name="Login successful?" default="Flow_ShopLoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ShopLoginFailure" name="Login rejected"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOrder" name="Receive order submission" messageRef="Message_OrderSubmission"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare payment and shipment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentReady" name="Notify customer payment is ready" messageRef="Message_PaymentReady"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Payment and shipment prepared"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrderDetailsSplit" name="Wait for payment and address details"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePaymentStatus" name="Receive payment confirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAddress" name="Receive address details" messageRef="Message_ShippingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrderDetailsJoin" name="Payment and address steps complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalizeOrder" name="Finalize order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderComplete" name="Order complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_1" sourceRef="Start_LoginRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Task_SendLoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_3" sourceRef="Task_SendLoginResult" targetRef="Gateway_ShopLoginSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShopLoginYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ShopLoginSuccess" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">loginSuccessful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShopLoginFailure" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ShopLoginSuccess" targetRef="End_ShopLoginFailure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrder" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_5" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_PaymentPreparation" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_ShipmentPreparation" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_6" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_7" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentReady" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_8" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_9" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_OrderDetailsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_PaymentWait" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderDetailsSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_AddressWait" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderDetailsSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_10" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePaymentStatus" targetRef="Gateway_OrderDetailsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_11" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAddress" targetRef="Gateway_OrderDetailsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_12" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderDetailsJoin" targetRef="Task_FinalizeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shop_13" sourceRef="Task_FinalizeOrder" targetRef="End_OrderComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Bank" name="Bank payment confirmation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PaymentData" name="Receive payment data">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PaymentData" messageRef="Message_PaymentData"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmPayment" name="Confirm payment"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendBankConfirmation" name="Send payment confirmation" messageRef="Message_BankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BankConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_1" sourceRef="Start_PaymentData" targetRef="Task_ConfirmPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_2" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmPayment" targetRef="Task_SendBankConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_3" sourceRef="Task_SendBankConfirmation" targetRef="End_BankConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
